title: Decoding spatial and semantic information from large-scale visual cortical activity for natural-movie reconstruction
title_zh: 从大规模视觉皮层活动中解码空间与语义信息以重建自然电影

paragraphs.en: Ca2REAL从大规模钙成像活动中解码布局与语义信息，重建自然电影达到81.4%辨识准确率。 Reconstructing natural visual experience from cortical population activity is a central challenge in neural decoding, particularly for calcium imaging, where signals are noisy, temporally filtered, and paired neural-video data are limited. Here we present Ca2REAL (Calcium Activity to Reconstruct Events, Appearance, and Layout), a neural-to-video framework that conditions a pretrained video diffusion model through separate layout and semantic controls derived from calcium activity. Using measured responses from 7,863 V1 neurons in one mouse, Ca2REAL reconstructed held-out natural-movie clips with 81.4% all-pairs stimulus-identification accuracy, with its clearest gains over deterministic baselines in perceptual and semantic measures. We further evaluated the framework in a stimulus-aligned virtual population of 116,705 neurons assembled from encoding-model-predicted responses across 11 independently recorded datasets. Perturbation and ablation analyses showed that reconstruction depends on distributed, stimulus-specific population structure, with layout and semantic pathways providing complementary spatial and identity information. Temporal analyses further showed improved preservation of semantic dynamics across reconstructed clips. These results show that large-scale cortical population activity constrains the spatial, semantic, and temporal structure of natural visual experience, providing a generative framework for high-fidelity neural reconstruction of dynamic visual scenes.
paragraphs.zh: 从皮层群体活动中重建自然视觉体验是神经解码的核心挑战，尤其是钙成像场景：信号噪声大、经过时间滤波，且配对的神经-视频数据有限。Ca2REAL 从大规模钙成像活动中解码布局与语义信息，重建自然电影达到81.4%辨识准确率。 我们提出 Ca2REAL（Calcium Activity to Reconstruct Events, Appearance, and Layout，钙活动重建事件、外观与布局），这是一个神经信号到视频的框架，通过从钙活动中导出的布局控制与语义控制两条独立通路，对预训练视频扩散模型进行条件化。 使用单只小鼠 7,863 个 V1 神经元的实测响应，Ca2REAL 重建留出的自然电影片段，达到 81.4% 的全对刺激辨识准确率，在感知与语义指标上相对确定性基线取得最明显的优势。 我们进一步在由 11 个独立记录数据集的编码模型预测响应组装而成、包含 116,705 个神经元的刺激对齐虚拟群体上评估该框架。 扰动与消融分析表明，重建依赖于分布式、刺激特异的群体结构，其中布局通路与语义通路提供互补的空间与身份信息。 时间分析进一步显示，重建片段中语义动态的保真度得到提升。 这些结果表明，大规模皮层群体活动约束了自然视觉体验的空间、语义与时间结构，为动态视觉场景的高保真神经重建提供了生成式框架。
